STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
Sahbhagi Dhan / BRRI Dhan 56 / Sukha Dhan 3 (IR 74371-70-1-1-CRR-1): Released in 2009 and notified in 2011, Sahbhagi Dhan is a conventionally bred drought-tolerant variety for commercial cultivation in India, Nepal (Sukha Dhan 3) and Bangladesh (BRRI Dhan 56). It has the potential to yield well under drought conditions due to its ability to have better grain setting under drought.
Parent variety: IR 55419-4*2/WAY RAREM. Duration in days: 105-110. Suitable land type: Upland and upper shallow lowland. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 95-105 cm. Yield: 4-4.7 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
IR64-Drt1 / DRR 42 (IR 87707-445-B-B-B-RP 5208-3; IET 22836): DRR 42 is the improved version of another popular variety IR 64 developed through marker-assisted breeding. Along with drought-tolerance potential, it has an added advantage of high yield production. Tolerant to drought, especially drought at flowering and grain filling stage. Resistant to blast, moderately resistant to bacterial blight and brown spot.
Parent variety: Aday Sel/*3 IR 64. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 115-120. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 100-105 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
DRR 43 (IR 83876-B-B-RP 5124-11-6-2; IET 22080): This variety has been released for commercial cultivation in India. Apart from good yield potential and drought tolerance, it has good grain quality and is resistant to blast, moderately resistant to BLB, BPH and WBPH.
Parent variety: IR 03L03/IR 1148. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 115-120. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Long bold. Plant height: 100-105 cm. Yield: 4-5.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
DRR 44 / Hardinath 3 (IR 93376-B-B-130): It is the latest released drought-tolerant rice variety in India and Nepal (Hardinath 3). Has excellent yield potential, good grain quality and drought tolerance. Resistant to blast, moderately resistant to bacterial leaf blight (BLB).
Parent variety: IR 71700-247-1-1-2/IR 03 L120. Year of notification: 2016. Duration in days: 120. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 100-105 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
Sukha Dhan 5 (IR 83388-B-B-108-3): Sukha Dhan 5 is another drought-tolerant, good-yielding variety released in Nepal.
Parent variety: IR8383B-B-108. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 125. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Medium fine. Plant height: 89-105 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
Sukha Dhan 6 (IR 83383-B-B-129-4): Sukha Dhan 6 has both submergence as well as drought-tolerant characteristics. This variety is released in Nepal. Resistant to bacterial leaf blight, blast, and brown spot.
Parent variety: IR83383-B-B-129-4 (IR 72022-46-2-3-3-2/IR57514-PMI-5-B-1-2). Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 120-125. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland and mid low land. Grain type: Medium fine. Plant height: 95-102 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 57 (BR 7873-5*): A drought-tolerant rice variety released in Bangladesh.
Parent variety: BR11, ICR 146-7027-224. Year of notification: 2010. Duration in days: 100-105. Suitable land type: Upland. Grain type: Slender. Plant height: 110-115 cm. Yield: 4-4.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 66 (IR 82635-B-B-75-2): A drought-tolerant variety released in Bangladesh.
Parent variety: IR 8875-176-B-2, IR 78875-207-B-3. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 110-115. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 118-120 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 71 (IR82589-B-B-84-3): A drought-tolerant variety released in Bangladesh.
Parent variety: IR 55423-01 (NSIC RC 9), IRRI 148. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 114-117. Suitable land type: Shallow lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 107-108 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Drought-tolerant rice variety.
Swarna Shreya (IET 24003) (RCPR-8-IR 84899-B-179-16-1-1-1): Swarna Shreya is a high-yielding, semi-dwarf, early-maturity rice variety suitable for cultivation in aerobic conditions or water-limiting areas in Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Bihar states. It is moderately resistant to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath rot and RTD diseases. It also showed moderate resistance to major pests like stem borer, leaf folder, gall midge (biotype 1) and whorl maggot under natural screening.
Parent variety: IR 78877-208-B-1-1 / IRRI 132. Year of notification: 2016. Duration in days: 120-125. Suitable land type: Water-limiting irrigated lowland, rainfed shallow lowland and medium upland. Grain type: Long bold. Plant height: 105-110 cm. Yield: 4.29-5.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
Swarna Sub 1 / BRRI Dhan 51 (IR05F102): Swarna Sub 1 has submergence tolerance up to 2 weeks, because of the Sub 1 gene. This variety is widely grown in flood-prone ecologies of Odisha, WB, Bihar and other eastern states of India along with Bangladesh.
Parent variety: Swarna*3/IR 49830-7-1-2-2. Duration in days: 140-145. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Medium bold. Plant height: 100 cm. Yield: 5.5-6.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
BINA Dhan 11 (Ciherang-Sub1, IR09F436): This submergence-tolerant variety is the version of the Indonesian mega variety called Ciherang. It can tolerate complete submergence for 2 weeks. The variety has good grain quality, which provides the promising potential to replace other existing low-yielding varieties.
Parent variety: IRRI149, Ciherang. Year of notification: 2015. Duration in days: 120. Suitable land type: Medium lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 107-115 cm. Yield: 5.5-6 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
CR 1009 Sub 1 (IR07F291): CR 1009 Sub 1 is one of the highest-yielding rice varieties. It can tolerate complete submergence for 2 weeks. This variety is the flood-tolerant version of CR 1009 (Savitri).
Parent variety: IR49830-7-1-2-2, CR1009. Year of notification: 2017. Duration in days: 150-155. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Short bold. Plant height: 110-120 cm. Yield: 6-6.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
Samba Mahsuri Sub 1 / BINA 12 (IR07F101): Samba Mahsuri Sub 1 is the medium-duration, fine-grain-quality flood-tolerant rice variety. It can tolerate complete submergence for 2 weeks. It is the flood-tolerant version of Samba Mahsuri (BPT5204), which is the largest non-basmati export rice variety in India. Also released in Bangladesh.
Parent variety: IR49830-7-1-2-2, Samba Mahsuri. Duration in days: 135. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 80-85 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
Ranjit Sub 1 (Ranjit/Swarna Sub 1//Ranjit): Suitable for cultivation in lowland areas. Submergence-tolerance capacity up to two weeks.
Parent variety: IR49830-7-1-2-2, Ranjit. Year of notification: 2018. Duration in days: 150-155. Suitable land type: Lowland areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 105-110 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
Bahadur Sub 1 (Bahadur/Swarna Sub 1//Bahadur): Suitable for cultivation in lowland areas. Submergence-tolerance capacity up to two weeks.
Parent variety: IR49830-7-1-2-2, Bahadur. Year of notification: 2018. Duration in days: 150-155. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 105-110 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Flood-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 52 (IR85260-66-654-Gaz2): Submergence tolerance up to 2 weeks.
Parent variety: IR40931-33-1-3-2, BR11. Year of notification: 2010. Duration in days: 140-145. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 116 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
CSR 36 (IET 17340): CSR-36 is a medium-duration salt-tolerant variety which was developed by CSSRI for saline and sodic areas of the country.
Parentage: CSR 13/Panvel 2//IR 36. Year of notification: 2005. Duration in days: 130-135. Stress suitability/tolerance: Can tolerate soil stress up to pH range 9.6-9.8 (sodic) and ECe 6-10 dSm-1 (saline). Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 110-112 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
CSR 43 (CSR-89IR-8): CSR 43 is a short-duration salt-tolerant variety, which matures ~20 days earlier than the other prevailing varieties by the end of October. It helps in timely sowing of wheat. This variety has huge potential in sodic soil of UP and Bihar and is also becoming popular in other areas due to its earliness with good grain quality.
Parentage: KHAO DAWK MALI 105/IR 4630-22-2-5-1-3//IR 20925-33-3-1-1-28 IR49737-3B-28-2B. Year of notification: 2014 (for sodic soils of UP). Duration in days: 105-110. Stress suitability/tolerance: Can tolerate up to pH range 9.5-9.7; high potential in sodic soil and suitable for inland salt-affected areas. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 96-100 cm. Yield: 4.5-5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
CR Dhan 405 (CR 2577-1): It is an early-duration salt-tolerant variety released for cultivation in coastal saline areas of India for the dry season.
Parentage: IR72046-B-R-3-3-3-1. Year of notification: 2012 (for coastal saline of Odisha). Duration in days: 105-110. Stress suitability/tolerance: Suitable up to pH range 5.0-8.0 dS/M and for coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 110 cm. Yield: 4.5-5.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
CR Dhan 406 (CR2092-158-3; IET 19472): It is a long-duration salt-tolerant variety released for cultivation in coastal saline areas of Odisha. Resistant to yellow stem borer and moderately resistant to sheath blight and bacterial leaf blight.
Parentage: Jaya/Lunishree. Year of notification: 2012. Duration in days: 150-155. Stress suitability/tolerance: Suitable up to ECe range 5.0-8.0 dS/m in coastal saline areas. Grain type: Short bold. Plant height: 120 cm. Yield: 5.0-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
DRR 39 / Jag Jeevan (IET-19487): This is a salt-tolerant variety released by the Directorate of Rice Research, Hyderabad (DRR) for coastal areas and has good grain quality. Resistant to blast and BPH, moderately resistant to WBPH. It is tolerant to both salinity and drought.
Parentage: CSR3/Kasturi. Year of notification: 2009. Duration in days: 130-135. Stress suitability/tolerance: Suitable for coastal saline areas. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 105-110 cm. Yield: 5.0-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 47 (IR63307-4B-4-3): A salinity-tolerant variety released in Bangladesh.
Parentage: IR 51511-B-B-34-B/TCCP 266-2-49-B-B-3. Year of notification: 2007. Duration in days: 140-150. Stress suitability/tolerance: Highly saline (8-10 dS/m) coastal saline areas. Grain type: Short bold. Plant height: 100 cm. Yield: 4.0-7.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BINA Dhan 8 (IR66946-3R-149-1-1): Salinity tolerance up to 12 dS/m.
Parentage: IR 29/POKKALI. Year of notification: 2010. Duration in days: 130-135. Stress suitability/tolerance: Highly coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium bold. Plant height: 90-95 cm. Yield: 5.5-6.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 55 (IR73678-6-9-B): Salinity tolerance up to 8 dS/m, moderate drought and moderate cold tolerant.
Parentage: IR64, Oryza rufipogon. Year of notification: 2011. Duration in days: 145. Stress suitability/tolerance: Moderate coastal saline acid soils and medium upland areas. Grain type: Long slender. Plant height: 100 cm. Yield: 6.0-7.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BINA Dhan 10 (IR64197-3B-14-2): Salinity tolerance up to 10 dS/m.
Parentage: IR42598-B-B-B-B-12/NONA BOKRA. Year of notification: 2012. Duration in days: 125-130. Stress suitability/tolerance: Coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 100-110 cm. Yield: 5.5-6.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 61 (BR7105-4R-2): Salinity tolerance up to 12 dS/m.
Parentage: IR64419-3B-4-3/BRRI dhan29. Year of notification: 2013. Duration in days: 145-150. Stress suitability/tolerance: Coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 95 cm. Yield: 5.5-6.0 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 67 (BR7100-3R-6-6): Salinity tolerance up to 12 dS/m.
Parentage: IR61247-3B-8-2-1/BRRI dhan36. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 140-150. Stress suitability/tolerance: Coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 100 cm. Yield: 3.8-7.4 t/ha (depends on salinity-stress condition) and 6-7.5 t/ha (in non-stress condition).

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Salinity-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 73 (IR78761-B-SATB1-28-3-24): Salinity tolerance up to 12 dS/m.
Parentage: BRRI dhan40/IR 61920-3B-22-1-1. Year of notification: 2014. Duration in days: 120-125. Stress suitability/tolerance: Coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 120-125 cm. Yield: 3.5-6 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Multi stress-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 79 (BR9159-8-5-40-14-57): Submergence and stagnant water tolerance up to 2 weeks.
Parent variety: BRRI Dhan49, BRRI Dhan52. Year of notification: 2017. Duration in days: 135-140. Suitable land type: Lowland. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 110-112 cm. Yield: 5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Multi stress-tolerant rice variety.
CR Dhan 801 (IR 96322-34-223-B-1-1-1-CR 3955-2) - Drought & Submergence: It is tolerant to both submergence and drought. Released in India.
Parent variety: IET 25667 (IR 96322-34-223-B-1-1-1-CR 3955-2) IR 81896-B-B-195/2*IR05F102//IR 91659-54-35. Year of notification: Not yet notified. Duration in days: 125-130. Suitable land type: Medium shallow lowland. Grain type: Short bold. Plant height: 80-98 cm. Yield: 5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia) - Multi stress-tolerant rice variety.
BRRI Dhan 78 (IR77092-B-2R-B-10) - Salinity & Submergence: Salinity tolerance up to 8 dS/m and submergence up to 2 weeks. Released in Bangladesh.
Parent variety: IR 84649 cross. Year of notification: 2016. Duration in days: 130-135. Suitable land type: Tidal/coastal saline areas. Grain type: Medium slender. Plant height: 120 cm. Yield: 4.5-5.5 t/ha.

STRVs stress-tolerant rice varietal catalogue (South Asia). About STRASA: Since 2007, IRRI's project Stress-Tolerant Rice for Africa and South Asia (STRASA), in collaboration with AfricaRice, delivered rice varieties tolerant to abiotic stresses benefitting nearly 18 million farmers in South Asia and Sub-Sahara cultivating rice in unfavourable environments. Supported by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, it is a collaborative effort to develop and deliver high-yield rice varieties tolerant to abiotic stresses: submergence, drought, and salinity in South Asia and submergence, drought, salinity, cold and iron toxicity in Africa. Contact: Stress-tolerant Rice for Africa and South Asia (STRASA), International Rice Research Institute, First Floor, CG-Block, NASC Complex, Dev Prakash Shastri Marg, Pusa Campus, New Delhi - 110 012, India. strasa.irri.org
